verdict.rationale: LM Studio documents a native v1 REST API, OpenAI-compatible endpoints, a headless daemon (llmster) and an `lms` CLI that cover major UI functions: chat, model search and download, loading with GPU and context options, and server start/stop. Nothing shows the API reaches every UI feature, such as document attachment/RAG, MCP server management, chat folders or regeneration history, or Bionic document editing. Missing for 10: documented API/CLI coverage of RAG, MCP, chat organization and Bionic features, an explicit parity statement, and independent confirmation of API completeness.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can do everything through the API that I can do in the UI

citations.quote: LM Studio provides a REST API that you can use to interact with your local models from your own apps and scripts.
llmster is the headless version of LM Studio, no desktop app required.

Headless mode, or "Local LLM Service", enables you to leverage LM Studio's technology (completions, chat completions, embedding, structured outputs via `llama.cpp` or `Apple MLX`) as local server powering your app.
